DIAGNOSIS READY: Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma (likely Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma) with splenic involvement.
The combination of B symptoms, supraclavicular lymphadenopathy, elevated LDH, and confirmed splenomegaly is highly suggestive of a lymphoproliferative disorder.
